source: OpenStreetMap building footprints and building:levels tags
height_policy: Estimated shell height = OSM building:levels × the existing M2 profile's estimated storey pitch. This is a visual proxy, not a measured building height.

ground_reference.note: The current Godot ground plane is a provisional local Y=0 reference; it is not tied to a verified vertical datum.

vertical_offset_policy: OSM layer tags are preserved as relative stacking metadata only. No vertical offset is inferred from layer=-1.
collision_policy: Visual-only shell. Existing estimated proxy collision remains active until footprint overlap, route clearance and vertical circulation are independently reviewed.
